articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in early July 2026, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a larger effective context window. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between LLM capabilities and domain-expert performance in several STEM fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Demonstrates Gemini-Powered Robot That Learns Household Tasks from Video
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled a system integrating Gemini 2.5's vision-language capabilities with a general-purpose humanoid platform, enabling robots to learn novel household manipulation tasks by watching a single human demonstration video. The approach eliminates the need for teleoperation data collection and achieved an 87% first-attempt success rate across 40 unseen tasks in kitchen and living-room environments.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 288B Active Parameters via Mixture-of-Experts
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts model with 288 billion active parameters drawn from over a trillion total, under a permissive license. Early community benchmarks show it rivaling proprietary frontier models on reasoning and multilingual tasks, fueling a new wave of enterprise fine-tuning and on-premises deployments for regulated industries.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Third Factory
articles.summary: Figure announced the expansion of its humanoid robot workforce to a third BMW manufacturing facility in South Carolina, bringing the total deployment to over 200 units performing bin-picking, parts inspection, and kitting tasks. The robots now operate across two full shifts with a reported 96% uptime, marking one of the largest commercial humanoid deployments to date.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Constitutional Classifiers for Enterprise Safety Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new suite of constitutional classifiers designed to let enterprise customers define domain-specific safety boundaries using natural-language rules rather than traditional fine-tuning. The system runs as a lightweight inference-time layer that reduces harmful output rates by over 90% on adversarial red-team benchmarks while adding less than 50ms of latency, addressing a key pain point for regulated-industry AI adoption.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of A14 2nm Chips, Apple and Nvidia Among First Customers
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started high-volume manufacturing on its N2 process node at the Kaohsiung fab, with Apple and Nvidia receiving initial wafer shipments for next-generation mobile SoCs and data-center GPUs. The 2nm node uses gate-all-around transistors to deliver roughly 15% more speed and 30% lower power versus the 3nm node, setting the stage for a new class of efficient AI inference chips.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Trial
articles.summary: Neuralink received FDA approval to begin human clinical trials of its N2 implant, which features twice the electrode count of the original device and a wireless data throughput exceeding 10 Mbps. The expanded trial will enroll up to 50 patients with spinal cord injuries and aims to demonstrate not only cursor control but also direct neural control of robotic arm manipulators.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Shows Autonomous Construction Site Navigation with Real-Time Replanning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released footage of its electric Atlas humanoid autonomously navigating an active construction site, dynamically replanning paths around moving heavy equipment and uneven terrain without any pre-mapped environment data. The system combines onboard LiDAR SLAM with a vision-language planner that interprets safety signage and worker gestures, representing a significant step toward deploying humanoids in unstructured industrial environments.
